note: Ranged is used primarily for Zebak, Akkha and the Wardens. Twisted bow dominates at Zebak because it scales with the target's Magic level. Zaryte crossbow is kept for its special attack.

slots.note: Bow of faerdhinen with full crystal armour beats a Masori and crossbow setup, because crystal gives it 30% accuracy and 15% damage that no stat line shows. Eclipse atlatl wants full Eclipse moon.

note: Magic is used primarily for Akkha and the Wardens. Tumeken's shadow receives a 4x buff inside the raid and is all but required to mage Zebak, whose magic defence is otherwise too high.
Melee is used predominantly throughout the raid, so every role brings the best melee gear available.

slots.note: Scythe hits three times against large targets, which no stat line shows.

note: Twisted bow excels against the high-Magic bosses, notably Maiden and Xarpus. Rangers usually bring 15-25 black chinchompas and a twisted buckler for groups.

slots.note: Twisted bow damage scales with the target's Magic level.

note: The freezer needs Ice Barrage for mandatory Nylocas containment. Maging in elite void saves considerable inventory space.
Crush is needed for Tekton; Vasa's crystals want stab. Elder maul and Dragon warhammer give a guaranteed defence reduction on their first hit at Tekton, and should land before a Bandos godsword.

slots.note: Dragon hunter lance gains a hidden bonus against draconic targets in the raid.

note: Twisted bow scales with the target's Magic level, which is why it dominates here despite ordinary-looking stats.

slots.note: Bow of faerdhinen needs full crystal armour to reach its potential, and ignores the ammo slot.
Tumeken's shadow triples magic bonuses from gear, so it changes what the rest of the setup is worth.

A tome only helps while you are casting that element's spells. With a powered staff - Tumeken's shadow, Eye of ayak, Sanguinesti - you attack with the staff itself, so the tome does nothing and the ward's magic damage is worth more.

note: The Twisted bow is the single most influential investment here, because it scales with the target's Magic level and both Jad and Zuk are high-Magic.

slots.note: Bow of faerdhinen is the affordable alternative, but needs full crystal armour.

note: Scythe of vitur is the highest overall DPS here. A melee-only setup is strongly discouraged for a first quiver.
Tumeken's shadow is the only viable magic weapon for clearing waves.

Salve amulet (ei) and a Slayer helmet do not stack - you get one or the other, so pick whichever is higher. Many players run full Elite void with the salve; Masori with a Slayer helmet and an Anguish is the stronger setup if you have it. Vorkath is undead, so the salve applies at all.

slots.note: Only while on a matching Slayer task, where the imbued helm's 16.67% accuracy and damage beats anything else in this slot. Off task it does nothing at all - use Masori mask (f) instead.
Salve (ei) beats Anguish here because Vorkath is undead.
Dragonfire protection is required, not optional.

note: A Dragonfire shield is not required, but worth bringing if you are not running super antifire potions. Salve amulet (ei) and a Slayer helmet do not stack here - use whichever is better, not both.

slots.note: Only while on a matching Slayer task, where the imbued helm's 16.67% accuracy and damage beats anything else in this slot. Off task it does nothing at all - use Torva full helm instead.

note: This is the setup. A Zaryte crossbow with Ruby dragon bolts (e) beats everything else here - the ruby proc hits for a flat 100, which against her health pool is worth far more than a bigger max hit. Melee with an Osmumten's fang works for the accuracy re-roll but is not recommended, and magic is the weakest of the three.

slots.note: Twisted bow is far better against the minions and Blood reavers.

note: Not recommended, but workable. An Osmumten's fang is the weapon for it, because its accuracy re-roll is what gets through her +260 Defence. Ranged with ruby bolts is materially better.
